# book_capability (Resource)

The capability records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the capability.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the capability.
- `value` (Dynamic) Capability payload consumed when the capability is applied.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free form notes about the capability.
- `input` (Dynamic) A JSON schema of what a booking on an object carrying the capability must supply under input.<capability id>, validated at booking. Null when the capability asks for nothing.
- `locale` (Map of Map of String) Locale specific labels keyed by language tag.
- `render` (String) Render directive applied when expanding the capability.
- `type` (String) Free form user defined type label
